subject: Application — Site Supervisor for Highway Bridge Project
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Site Supervisor position for the Highway Bridge Project (Gamma).

Professional Summary:
- 12 years of experience in civil engineering and construction
- 4 bridge projects completed (2 highway, 2 rail)
- Managed teams of 50+ workers

Certifications:
- Professional Engineer (PE)
- PMP Certified
- OSHA-30 Construction Safety

Key Skills:
- Bridge construction and pile driving
- Team management and subcontractor coordination
- Quality control and safety compliance
- Primavera P6 and AutoCAD proficient

I am available for an interview at your convenience.

Best regards,
Raj Kumar
Phone: +91-98765-43210
